summary: Frontend-only QA of /admin/settings (Admin Platform Settings dashboard). Verified all 10 group tabs render, kill-switch toggle opens step-up modal and does not mutate until confirmed, VALID TOTP applies the change (chip -> ACTIVE, source=Override) and WRONG TOTP shows ps-stepup-error without logging the admin out. Fees edit flow (fees.transaction_fee_percent) works end-to-end: Save disabled until change, step-up modal, confirm with valid code -> source=Override + revert button appears, revert -> source=Environment and value 1.5 (confirmed via GET /api/admin/settings). Read-only chip on safedeal.fee_percent present with no Save control. History drawer (ps-history-drawer) opens with ps-history-row-* entries. All testids match spec.

ui_bugs.issue: No per-row Revert affordance on kill-switch toggle rows when override exists but value equals default (e.g. killswitch.pause_checkouts override=false). ps-row-<key>-revert is not rendered for kill-switch group, only for numeric SettingRow. Leaves a residual tbl_platform_setting row after toggling off that only the DB cleanup can remove.

action_items: Main agent: DELETE leftover tbl_platform_setting row killswitch.pause_checkouts (value=false, source=override) created during QA toggle-off step. Value is safe (same as default) but context requires empty table.
Consider surfacing a Revert control on kill-switch cards too so admins can clear an override row without a second toggle round-trip.
critical_code_review_comments: Step-up modal correctly guards both PUT and POST revert; axiosAdmin exemption on 401/403 for step-up works (admin stayed on /admin/settings on wrong code).
History drawer initial render had a brief empty state before fetch resolved; adding a loading skeleton or awaited open would be polish.
